claim: Opening paragraph: "The website is a bare four-page site marked © 2022, with no services, hours or prices as readable text."
problem: Contradicted by the site itself. The /services page states the service families as readable text (DIGITAL, OFFSET, SCREEN, SIGNS plus Binding & Finishing, Western Union, Passport Photos) and /contact shows readable hours ("Open today 08:30 am – 05:30 pm") plus the address. The site genuinely has no prices and the home page carries no service/hour text, but as written the sentence says the whole site has none.
fix: Scope it to the home page: "The site is a four-page © 2022 GoDaddy build; the home page carries only a logo, one stock photo and the footer, with no services, address, hours or prices as text, and no prices anywhere on the site."

claim: For the founder (email): "A customer can't see what you print, get any sense of price, or send artwork."
problem: The first clause is contradicted: the Services page lists what they print (digital, offset/raised, screen-printed apparel, signs, binding, Western Union, passport photos). Sending a 40-year owner a note saying customers cannot see what he prints reads as a failure to look at his site. The second and third clauses (no prices, no artwork upload) are accurate.
fix: Replace with something true and more damaging: "the Services page is a one-screen bullet list with no stock, sizes, turnaround or price, and the form asks for a message rather than a quantity or a file."

claim: Hourly rate used in all three impact lines: "at $28.75/hour (O*NET Customer Service Rep median, NJ, x1.25 benefits)".
problem: Slight overstatement. The O*NET NJ figure is $47,740/yr and $22.95/hr; $22.95 x 1.25 = $28.69, not $28.75 (which appears to come from rounding $47,740 to "$23/hour" first). The effect is a few dollars per year, but the number is presented as an exact derivation.
fix: Use $28.69/hour (or "about $28.70") and state the derivation once: $47,740 NJ median / 2,080 hours = $22.95, x1.25 = $28.69. Impact ranges restated as roughly $1,148–$4,304 / $1,061–$4,590 / $487–$946.

claim: Sources note: "Customer Service Rep median wage, NJ (no survey year shown on the page used)".
problem: Contradicted. The O*NET local-wages page cites "Bureau of Labor Statistics 2025 wage data" and is footed "Site updated October 6, 2026". The year is shown and is current, so the caveat understates the source and looks like an excuse.
fix: Replace the parenthetical with "(BLS OEWS 2025, as republished by O*NET for New Jersey)".

claim: "Downtown Printing Center has printed at 46 Paterson St. since 1977".
problem: Half-verified. The About Us page says the firm has served New Brunswick since 1977 and is in the downtown district, but never ties 1977 to 46 Paterson St.; the earliest source locating them at that address is a 1990 directory entry used in the profile. As stated, the same-address-since-1977 link is an inference presented as fact.
fix: "Downtown Printing Center has printed in downtown New Brunswick since 1977 and has been at 46 Paterson St. for decades — digital, offset, apparel, signs, counter services."

claim: Section 3: "four families each carry different stocks".
problem: Not stated in any source. The Services page lists product families and items but says nothing about stocks or paper specs; the claim is a reasonable assumption dressed as an observation in a document that otherwise separates facts from assumptions.
fix: Either mark it ("as you'd expect, each family runs on its own stock and spec sheet — ours, not measured") or drop it and keep "we found no published prices or samples".
